decisions.reason: As software very close to the firm's core automation and digital-service trajectory, it remains a low-cost option to keep open even if it may be folded into broader solutions rather than promoted as a standalone product.

After several years with only limited visibility, this narrower mechanical niche likely has revealed enough about its modest upside that releasing resources is preferable to continuing to carry the option.

Control technology for water-engineering machinery fits the firm's established competencies and customer base closely, so the option value of retaining it still outweighs the cost of keeping it in the portfolio.

Because it combines flow measurement, automation and software in a field aligned with the firm's connected and data-driven direction, management would usually keep it while market adoption continues to develop.
